headline: Weathered Expanse Rekindles as Linn Mercy Falls Silent
war_summary: Overnight wires reverse the evening picture, with the Weathered Expanse again the sharpest sector after three changes in the last two hours and thirty-eight on the day about Frostmarch, Crow's Nest and Shattered Advance, standing four Warden to five Colonial with day losses near 13,049 Colonial and 15,428 Warden and both hourly rates accelerating. Mooring County also stirs with two changes in two hours and eleven on the day centered on the Wind Hills, held eleven Warden to one Colonial with 4,000 Colonial and 3,438 Warden lost on the day and both rates quickening. Linn Mercy, the late leader about Lathair, records none in two hours after eight in six and seventeen on the day, still ten Colonial to one Warden with 3,884 Colonial and 6,537 Warden casualties. Stlican Shelf and Fisherman's Row likewise show none in two hours despite twenty and thirty-five on the day, about Thornhold and Black Well with Eidolo, while Stonecradle counts five on the day about World's End. Dead Lands, Callahan's Passage and Nevish Line report heavy casualties but no flips.
